TO: lois.errera@erickson.com
SUBJECT: Your after-hours calls are your best referrals — do you know where they go?

Hi there,

Quick one, from one operator to another: when a family calls your community at 7pm on a Friday and nobody answers, where does that family go? Usually to the next name on the list — and they rarely come back.

We fix exactly that. VES installs an AI front desk that answers every call, day or night, books the tour, and sends you a text summary of every missed call. One page explains it — and it takes 3 minutes to see if it fits Charlestown Community, Inc:

https://bilts.org

If it looks like a fit, the button on that page books a free 15-minute audit. No obligation, no jargon — we look at your call flow and show you exactly what's falling through.

Serving those who served — and those who care for them,
